summary: Iteration 40 testing - Unified Travel Guide & Refine API. Backend: 7/7 tests PASS (100%). Frontend: ALL tests PASS. The new /api/ai/travel-plan/refine endpoint works correctly, returning 400 for missing refinement or previous_plan. The unified guide UI merges Weather + Packing into header card with Itinerary, Checklist, Local Tips as separate sections. 'Ajustar plano' button shows inline refine input. All CTAs (booking, skyscanner, airalo, getyourguide) visible. Sticky bar appears on scroll. Mobile (375px) renders correctly.
